plan: successive-halving funnel: 300 screen -> 1000 confirm (top 2) -> 5071 full DEV (top 1-2)
token_budget_rationale: Frozen on COST grounds before any NDCG was observed, never tuned on results. 512 = 2x V2's 256. Measured truncation: ~30% of DEV pairs at 512 vs V2's 48.1% at 256, so every modern config sees strictly MORE text than the frozen baseline did. 1024 would cut truncation to ~8% but roughly doubles inference cost, which would put the eventual full-DEV Jina listwise run near 14 h; 512 keeps it near 7 h. The budget is held constant across all three funnel rounds so numbers stay comparable.
truncation_policy: priority query>title>brand>color kept whole (139 tokens even at p99); remaining budget to bullet then description; never a blind tail cut
known_confound: V2 was trained AND evaluated at max_length=256 (48.1% truncation); the zero-shot models are evaluated at 512 (~30%). Part of any gap is context, not architecture. Disclosed, not corrected -- crippling long-context models to 256 would be the worse distortion.
qwen_formulation_note: model card's sentence_transformers.CrossEncoder path raises 'Cannot handle batch sizes > 1 if no padding token is defined' on transformers 5.2.0 / ST 5.2.3; used the card's canonical transformers path instead (chat prefix/suffix + P(yes) over [no,yes] final-token logits).
